inspection_method: Actual image-tool viewing of every final rendered page

page_evidence.finding: Title, author, affiliation, abstract, definitions, positive-leg comparison and Theorem 1 are legible; initial-zero convention and library citation appear in ordinary text.
Endpoint-state decomposition, equations (2)-(4), and the full convolution lemma/proof are unclipped. Equation numbers and proof square are aligned.
Coefficient formulas, ten-center lemma and main proof are legible. The exact-verification section and filenames fit; no missing glyphs or unresolved cross-references.
Finite ranges and counts are printed correctly. Limitations and AI disclosure are explicit. All five compact formulas and the R,2 coefficient table are complete.
The R,3, S,2, S,3 and S,4 coefficient tables have clear exponent headers, integer cells and zero-as-blank convention. The widest nine-column table fits within margins.
All five bibliography entries are visible and legible, including the 27-author SymPy entry and distinction between Zijian and Xiaojian. URLs break within margins.
